text: @arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub 是 DSH 网页端插件，在设置中加入 Providers 面板，通过 DSH 原生接口管理模型路由。用户可配置 BharatCode 或 OpenAI 兼容服务，发现或手动维护模型并保存，也可嵌入已安装订阅插件的登录界面。适合需要在 DSH 中添加模型服务的用户。

@arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub adds a Providers panel to DSH web settings and manages routes through native DSH interfaces. Configure BharatCode or an OpenAI-compatible service, discover or edit models, and save routes; the panel can also embed an installed subscriptions plugin sign-in UI.
想在 DSH 设置里添加一个 OpenAI 兼容的模型 API。
能不能帮我发现某个模型服务支持的模型并保存到 DSH？
I want to configure a BharatCode provider and its models in DSH.
@arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub 的功能「配置模型提供方」：在网页 Providers 面板选预设或添加兼容路由，发现或手动编辑模型后保存到 DSH。

@arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub README · DSH Provider Hub：The hub uses DSH's native `llm-pi-ai` adapter and authenticated settings/credentials Remote APIs. It does not fork Harness or copy the subscription plugin. API keys go into DSH's credential store, not the provider configuration or browser storage.

@arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub README · Install：Use a DSH profile with the native `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter enabled (standard profiles already supply it). Install the prebuilt GitHub package:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub
```

If subscriptions are not installed in the same profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-subscriptions
```

@arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub README · Install：Restart DSH, then open **Settings → Providers**. For a web profile, substitute `web` for `desktop`. If the subscription plugin is already installed, keep that installation. A standalone archive is also available under [Releases](https://github.com/arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub/releases). Download it and pass its local `.tgz` path to the same `dsh plugin add` command.

@arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub README · Use：**BharatCode:** select BharatCode, enter your key, optionally discover the account's current models, review model capacities, and save. Select the provider/model in the conversation model picker. The preset uses `https://bharatcode.ai/api/model/v1`; its initial model IDs and capacities are defaults from the local integration, not a guarantee of current account availability.

@arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub README · Use：**Other endpoints:** select Add OpenAI-compatible, give it a unique route ID, enter the API base URL (include `/v1` or the gateway prefix), pick its API format and enter its key. Discover models or add IDs manually. Endpoints without discovery are supported through manual entries. A localhost server that accepts any key may use a placeholder key. Remote endpoints require HTTPS.

@arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub README · Use：**Subscriptions:** expand Manage subscription sign-in to use the installed plugin's original controls. ChatGPT subscriptions authenticate as Codex; GitHub subscriptions mean GitHub Copilot. An ordinary GitHub account does not itself provide paid Copilot models. Subscription inference and subscription account limits remain the upstream plugin's responsibility.

@arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub README · Use：Keys are never read back into the form. A blank key field keeps the stored key or the exported environment variable named in Key reference. The hub preserves route options such as headers, reasoning compatibility, retries and timeouts, and keeps existing per-model advanced options when a matching ID is retained. It uses the namespace's revision to reject stale saves. If settings save succeeds but credential storage fails, the page explains the partial save and asks you to retry the key.

@arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub README · Use：Model discovery runs inside the host. Missing context/output capacities use editable estimates of 32,768/4,096 tokens. Review these before saving. Discovery replaces the draft model list; saved models are the IDs in that draft. The hub does not remove existing routes; use DSH's native Models settings for advanced editing/removal.

@arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub README · Development and validation：```sh
git clone https://github.com/arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub.git
cd dsh-provider-hub
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm test
DSH_SOURCE=/path/to/deepseek-harness npm run test:composition
npm pack

@arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub README · Optional test against the real subscription UI and Harness slot registry:：DSH_SOURCE=/path/to/deepseek-harness \
SUBSCRIPTIONS_SOURCE=/path/to/unpacked/dsh-plugin-subscriptions \
  npm run test:compatibility
```
section: Optional test against the real subscription UI and Harness slot registry:

text: @arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub README · Optional test against the real subscription UI and Harness slot registry:：`test:composition` requires a built Harness checkout and Node 24. It creates an isolated temporary profile and local OpenAI-compatible test server, then exercises the real Loader, settings revision/write path, native credential store, model discovery, model catalog and streamed inference. It does not touch the desktop profile or use real account credentials. `npm test` runs standalone unit/UI tests without a Harness installation. `test:compatibility` additionally mounts the real subscription component and uses the real Harness slot registry. Subscription support is tested with the existing 0.9.7 settings component contract; future upstream UI changes may require adaptation.
